chunks: And al-Shaykh—may Allah, Exalted is He, support him—reported to me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was shrouded in three garments: a red hibarah cloak, and two white Suḥārī garments.”

I said to him: “And how was salat performed over him?” He said: “He was covered with a garment and placed in the middle of the house. Whenever a group entered upon him, they stood around him, performed salat over him, and supplicated for him; then they would leave and others would enter. Then ʿAlī عليه السلام entered the grave and placed him upon his hands, and he admitted al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbbās with him. Then a man from the Anṣār, from Banū al-Khuyalāʾ, called Aws ibn Khawallī, said: I adjure you by Allah not to cut off our right. So ʿAlī عليه السلام said to him: Enter. So he entered with the two of them. Then I asked him: Where was the bier placed? He said: At the foot of the grave, and he was drawn out gently.”
He said, and he said: “Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام shrouded Usāmah ibn Zayd in a hibarah cloak, and ʿAlī عليه السلام shrouded Sahl ibn Ḥunayf in a red hibarah cloak.”

key_terms.أَثْوَابٍ: burial garments or cloths used as a shroud
key_terms.السَّرِيرُ: the bier or funeral couch carrying the body
key_terms.الْقَبْرَ: the grave into which the deceased was buried
key_terms.حِبَرَةٍ: a patterned Yemeni cloth or cloak used here in the shroud
key_terms.سُلَّ: was drawn out or lowered smoothly and gently

ai.seo_question: How was the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم shrouded, prayed over, and buried according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the shrouding, funeral salat, and burial of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, including the garments used for his kafan and the manner in which people entered in groups to pray over him. It also records details of his burial by Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and mentions comparable shrouding practices by Imam al-Ḥasan and Imam ʿAlī عليهما السلام, giving historical and jurisprudential insight into funerary rites.
